proposed_widenings.name: apply_condition in spell Effect
proposed_widenings.justification: The on-fail branch of Contagion's initial save gate inflicts the Poisoned condition. Effect (used in ActivationPhase.onFail/onSuccess) only supports 'damage' and 'none'. The v4 atom apply_condition exists and is already reachable from mastery SaveGateRiderResult, but not from the spell Effect union.
proposed_widenings.evidence: the target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take 11d8 Necrotic damage and have the Poisoned condition

proposed_widenings.name: repeat_save ActivationPhase variant
proposed_widenings.justification: The end-of-turn repeated save accumulating 3 successes or 3 failures is structurally different from a one-shot save_gate. The v4 taxonomy has a repeat_save resolution atom (§5), but it is not a variant of ActivationPhase in the surface. A new ActivationPhase kind with success/failure counters and per-branch effects is needed.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The target must repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns until it gets three successes or failures. If the target succeeds on three of these saves, the spell ends on the target. If the target fails three of the saves, the spell lasts for 7 days on it.

proposed_widenings.name: modify_roll_advantage conditioned on active condition + chosen-ability parameter
proposed_widenings.justification: While Poisoned, the target has Disadvantage on saving throws made with ONE specific ability chosen at cast time. Two gaps: (1) modify_roll_advantage in spell effects must be gated on the target holding a specific active condition, and (2) the target ability is not a constant — it is a caster choice at cast time, which requires a new cast-time parameter mechanism in the surface.
proposed_widenings.evidence: choose one ability when you cast the spell. While Poisoned, the target has Disadvantage on saving throws made with the chosen ability

proposed_widenings.name: condition_persistence_gate (or protect_condition)
proposed_widenings.justification: Contagion blocks removal of the Poisoned condition behind a CON save: whenever any effect would end Poisoned, the target must save or the removal fails. No v4 atom covers this. It is not block_targeting (that blocks targeting, not condition-removal events), not negate_named_effect (that negates a specific named spell), not condition_progression (that models worsening conditions), and not repeat_save (that models repeated resolution checks). A new atom is needed: one that intercepts incoming remove_condition effects on a specific condition and gates them behind a save, consuming the remove attempt on a success and blocking it on a failure.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Whenever the Poisoned target receives an effect that would end the Poisoned condition, the target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw, or the Poisoned condition doesn't end on it.

notes: Contagion requires four widenings to encode honestly. Three are surface_widening (existing v4 atoms not yet exposed as surface variants): apply_condition in spell Effect, repeat_save as an ActivationPhase kind, and modify_roll_advantage with a condition-gate and cast-time ability selector. The fourth — condition_persistence_gate — is a genuine atom_widening with no v4 counterpart. The overall classification is atom_widening. No content/contagion.dhall written.
